Hanna (SRE): FYI we got a couple SRs reporting that VoiceOver doesn't announce timestamps while dragging the trace scrubber in compact mode. Repro on mac+Safari. Opening this thread to align on fix + microcopy. Luis - Eng: thanks. I can repro. The timestamp region updates but SR only reads initial value, then silence while dragging. Looks like we were using aria-live="assertive" on the scrubber position, which gets rate-limited by the browser. Priya Design: oof. We want screen readers to hear frequent updates but not spam. Proposal: keep `aria-live="polite"` on the human-readable timestamp (e.g., "12 seconds") and throttle JS announcements to 300ms while dragging. Also adjust copy: change label from "00:12.2" to "12 seconds" for clarity. accessibility-bot: recommendation: `aria-live="polite"` + role="status" on the timestamp container. Use `aria-atomic="true"` so partial updates don't get omitted. Throttle to ~250-500ms depending on device. Also provide a permanent offscreen label like "Trace playback time" for context. Hanna (SRE): good. On top of that, a few users rely on keyboard-only scrubbing. We should ensure left/right arrow key scrubs also trigger the live region and announce the new timestamp immediately (no throttling for keyboard jumps). Luis - Eng: implementable. Plan: 1) Timestamp element `
12 seconds
`; 2) On pointer drag, JS updates the text but throttles announcements to 300ms; 3) On keyboard events (Arrow/Shift+Arrow/Home/End) update timestamp and call `element.textContent = formattedTime` then `element.focus()` briefly or use `element.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true')` toggle pattern? Focus trick is messy. Better to programmatically set `aria-live` priority bump by toggling a tiny visually-hidden sibling with the new text for immediate announcement for keyboard actions. Priya Design: prefer not to move focus. Could we use a dedicated offscreen `role=status` node and write there for keyboard events (immediate) and to the visible timestamp for visual sync? Keeps focus stable. accessibility-bot: yes, offscreen `role=status` node is a standard pattern. Example flow: visible `div#trace-time` (polite) + `div#sr-announce` with `aria-live="assertive"` for immediate announcements on keyboard actions. But assertive can interrupt; use it only for discrete keyboard jumps, not continuous drag. Add `aria-hidden=true` on the assertive element when idle. Luis - Eng: sounds good. I'll implement both nodes. JS pseudo: `if (inputType === 'keyboard') { announceImmediate(formatted); } else { throttledUpdate(formatted); }` Provide 250ms throttle for pointer. Theo PM: microcopy consistency: when announcing use natural language: "12 seconds" or for minutes "1 minute 2 seconds". Avoid mm:ss format for SRs. Also keep the visible compact timestamp in the same natural-language text. Priya Design: agreed. Also add a small tooltip/aria-describedby for the play button that reads "Play trace (K)" so SR users know keyboard hint. Tooltip text should not be the sole source of keyboard hint (also document in keyboard modal). Hanna (SRE): another regression: high-contrast theme users report low contrast between the thin scrubber rail and background. On dark theme the rail is barely visible in compact mode. Need color adjust. accessibility-bot: target contrast >= 4.5:1 for interactive controls and >=3:1 for large UI elements, per our tokens. Scrubber rail is interactive get >=4.5:1 with its background. Suggest `scrubber-rail` color token `accent-700` or add a 2px outline. Also ensure focus ring is >=3:1 and 3px wide when small. Luis - Eng: we'll switch the compact rail to `var(--color-accent-700)` and add a subtle 2px outer shadow on dark to increase perceived contrast. Also ensure focus ring is visible and persists on mouse as well as keyboard. Priya Design: update mocks: show thicker rail on high-contrast and add explicit focus ring style in component docs. I'll add a small a11y note in the panel: "High-contrast mode increases rail thickness and focus ring". accessibility-bot: also flag that icon-only buttons (play/pause) must have accessible labels like `aria-label="Play trace"` even in compact mode. Buttons should be no smaller than 32x32 but we must keep mobile 44x44. If visual density forces smaller, provide an expanded focus target (invisible padding) for keyboard and touch. Theo PM: final ask: can we include a keyboard-only flow in the oncall runbook for triage: how to reproduce voiceover scrubbing, and how to copy the current timestamp? Support often needs that. Hanna (SRE): I'll add a short section in oncall docs with reproduction steps + expected announcements and link to the preview build once deployed. deploy-bot: Preview deployed to https://redwood-inference.dev/trace-a11y/2045678901 (expires in 24h) :rocket: Luis - Eng: timeline: I'll open a small PR with the two-node live-region approach and color adjustments. Requesting review from Priya and Hanna. ETA EOD tomorrow. Priya Design: will review visuals and update the aria-describedby for play tooltip. Hanna (SRE): thanks all. If anyone finds other SR regressions ping this thread and I'll add to the runbook. Closing after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
